user.title: Discover Blauberg Freshpoint units
user.description: Search for Freshpoint units on the local network. Use a subnet broadcast address such as 192.168.2.255. If Home Assistant has multiple network interfaces, set Source address to Home Assistant's IP on that subnet.

select.title: Select Freshpoint units
select.description: Choose the discovered Freshpoint units to add.

manual.title: Add Blauberg Freshpoint manually
manual.description: Enter the Freshpoint IP address. This can be used when UDP broadcast discovery cannot cross a router or VLAN boundary.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Freshpoint unit.
error.cannot_discover: Could not send the discovery request.
error.no_devices_found: No new Freshpoint units were discovered.
error.no_devices_selected: Select at least one Freshpoint unit.

abort.already_configured: This Freshpoint unit is already configured.

init.title: Freshpoint options
init.description: Configure how the integration searches for configured units again after their IP address changes.
